explication: Effect is a TypeScript library and monorepo for constructing typed, resource-safe application workflows. The central workflow is to compose an Effect, provide its required services through Layers, execute it with the runtime, and inspect its success or failure. The repository also supplies domain libraries for AI, clustering, HTTP, SQL, platform runtimes, and observability integrations. The README documents package roles; sampled core and cluster sources support only the specific internal relationships shown below, so other links are omitted where wiring was not evidenced.
